translated_title: Homicide Incidence in the State of Mexico Falls 56% from September 2024 to This Past June

meta_description: The daily homicide average in the State of Mexico fell from 6.6 to 2.8 as a single-command strategy across 15 eastern municipalities drove 3,330 arrests.
